lines.en: label mollycafe5:
scene cafe_night
I decide to spend another night at the cafe and see what Molly is up to.
lines.zh: 我决定再去咖啡馆消磨一个晚上，看看 Molly 在忙些什么。

lines.en: I wound up getting sidetracked along the way, so I’m a little later than normal, but they’re still open by the time I get there, so...at least that's good.
lines.zh: 路上被别的事岔开了，所以我比平时晚了一些，不过等我到的时候店里还开着，所以……至少这点是好的。

lines.en: After stepping closer to the counter and realizing there isn’t anyone behind it, however, I begin to wonder if I'm a little too late after all and that...Molly just forgot to lock the doors or something.
lines.zh: 可等我走近柜台、发现后面一个人也没有时，我开始怀疑自己是不是来得太晚了……说不定 Molly 只是忘了锁门什么的。

lines.en: That seems like a thing she would do.
lines.zh: 这种事她确实干得出来。

lines.en: But just as I'm about to leave, I hear some strange sound effects coming from the corner of the room...
lines.zh: 可就在我准备离开时，我听见房间角落里传来一阵奇怪的音效……

lines.en: scene black
scene mollyphonegame1
I take a step closer to the sounds to find none other than my favorite Irish student (Out of one total) tapping away at what I imagine is a game on her phone.
lines.zh: 我朝声音的方向走近一步，看到的不是别人，正是我最喜欢的那个爱尔兰学生（总共也就一个），正埋头戳着手机，我猜大概是在打游戏。

lines.en: She’s humming happily along with the song that's playing and is so wrapped up in it that she doesn’t even notice I’m here.
lines.zh: 她正跟着播放的曲子愉快地哼着，整个人沉浸其中，甚至没注意到我在这里。

lines.en: Would this be cause for concern if I were an actual customer? Of course.
lines.zh: 如果我是个真正的顾客，这情况该让人担心吧？当然。

lines.en: But I’m not, so I suppose I'll continue letting her do her thing until she notices me.
lines.zh: 但我不是，所以我想还是继续由着她去，直到她发现我为止。

lines.en: : Hmm hm hmmm. Hm hmmm hmm hmmm~
lines.zh: : 哼嗯嗯嗯。嗯嗯嗯哼嗯嗯嗯～

lines.en: : Hmmmm hm HMMMM. HMMM hmm HMMM~
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯哼嗯嗯嗯。嗯嗯哼嗯嗯嗯嗯～

lines.en: : HMMMMMM HMM HMM HMM HMMMHMMMM~
lines.zh: : 嗯——嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯～

lines.en: The song picks up the pace and Molly’s fingers begin to dance quicker across the screen.
lines.zh: 曲子的节奏加快，Molly 的手指在屏幕上跳得更快了。

lines.en: This must be one of those rhythm game things I’ve heard Ami talking about in the past.
lines.zh: 这应该就是以前听 Ami 提起过的那种音游吧。

lines.en: And even though Molly seems to be having a good time, I’m not sure if I want to just stand here and watch her for the next...however long I’m going to be here for.
lines.zh: 虽然 Molly 看起来玩得很开心，但我不确定自己是不是想就这么站着看她……看上不知多久。

lines.en: : Molly.
lines.zh: : Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame2
: AH! I DIDN’T DO IT, I SWEAR!
lines.zh: : 啊！不是我干的，我发誓！

lines.en: : ...Didn’t do what?
lines.zh: : ……没干什么？

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame3
: Oh. It’s you.
lines.zh: : 哦。是你啊。

lines.en: : Top o’ the mornin’, Sir.
lines.zh: : 早上好呀，先生。

lines.en: : It’s the middle of the night. And stop saying “Top o' the mornin'” just because you’re Irish. It’s cliche.
lines.zh: : 现在可是大半夜。还有，别因为你是爱尔兰人就老说「早上好呀」。太老套了。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame4
: I had to say it at least once, Sir. I think it's some sort of...unwritten rule for Irish characters.
lines.zh: : 我总得至少说一次吧，先生。我觉得这算是……爱尔兰角色的某种不成文规定。

lines.en: : Anyway, what are you up to? Playing a game?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，你在忙什么呢？打游戏？

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame5
: I {i}was{/i} in the middle of a full combo until you decided to show up and scare the pants off of me.
lines.zh: : 我{i}本来{/i}正在打全连呢，结果您突然冒出来，吓得我裤子都掉了。

lines.en: : Your pants are very much on right now.
lines.zh: : 你的裤子现在好好穿在身上呢。

lines.en: : My metaphorical pants. The ones I wear over my normal pants. They only come off when I get scared.
lines.zh: : 是我的、比喻意义上的裤子。就是套在正常裤子外面的那条。只有我被吓到的时候才会掉。

lines.en: : Molly, you’re a really weird girl. You know that, right?
lines.zh: : Molly，你真是个很怪的女孩。这点你自己知道吧？

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame6
: Yes! I've been being reminded for as long as I can remember. But that’s what makes me so lovable!
lines.zh: : 知道！从我记事起就一直有人这么提醒我。但正因如此我才这么惹人爱啊！

lines.en: : Besides, you’re pretty weird yourself. Aren’t you, Sir?
lines.zh: : 再说了，您自己也挺怪的。不是吗，先生？

lines.en: : In what way?
lines.zh: : 哪方面？

lines.en: : I used 'Detect Thoughts' on you when you weren’t paying attention in class the other day.
lines.zh: : 前几天您上课走神的时候，我对您用了「侦测思想」。

lines.en: : You think about some pretty unsavory things, Sir.
lines.zh: : 您脑子里想的东西可相当不健康呢，先生。

lines.en: As much as I want to say that the sort of magic Molly is referring to is impossible, I literally watched a girl her age reset the world a little while ago.
lines.zh: 我倒是很想说 Molly 提到的那种魔法根本不可能存在，可我不久前才亲眼看着一个跟她差不多大的女孩重置了世界。

lines.en: So I guess nothing is off limits, really.
lines.zh: 所以我想，大概真没什么是不可能的。

lines.en: But either way, I doubt Molly has actual mind-reading powers and that this was probably just a lucky guess.
lines.zh: 不过不管怎样，我怀疑 Molly 并没有真正的读心能力，这大概只是蒙对了。

lines.en: If she {i}actually{/i} had mind-reading powers, she would know that I've been picturing her without her clothes on this entire time.
lines.zh: 要是她{i}真{/i}能读心，那她早该知道，我从头到尾都在想象她不穿衣服的样子。

lines.en: : Okay, Molly. If you’re so smart, what am I thinking right-
lines.zh: : 好吧，Molly。既然你这么聪明，那我在想什——

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame7
: You really want me to say it, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您真的要我说出来吗，先生？

lines.en: : What if the security cameras in here record audio? You could get in a loooooooot of trouble~
lines.zh: : 万一这里的监控摄像头能录音呢？您可是会惹上大——大——大麻烦的哦～

lines.en: I'm just going to assume that she's only able to successfully guess these things because I am a generally creepy person.
lines.zh: 我就当她之所以能猜中这些，纯粹是因为我本身就是个变态吧。

lines.en: : As a growing boy, I believe I should be forgiven for all of the impure thoughts plaguing my mind.
lines.zh: : 作为一个还在发育的男生，我觉得脑海里那些不纯洁的念头应该得到宽恕。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame8
: That can't be true, Sir. You should have stopped growing a long time ago.
lines.zh: : 这说不通吧，先生。您早就该停止发育了。

lines.en: : Even I am barely growing at this point and you’re much older than I am.
lines.zh: : 我都已经基本不长了，而您比我大得多。

lines.en: : It was a joke, Molly. Now, I only grow when I get excited.
lines.zh: : 那是开玩笑，Molly。我现在只有兴奋的时候才会「长」。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame9
: Ahh! Penis joke!
lines.zh: : 啊！鸡巴梗！

lines.en: : I’ve read enough eroge to know what you mean by that!
lines.zh: : 我看过的成人游戏够多了，一听就懂您什么意思！

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that you were an expert in all things depressing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了你是「一切丧气事物」方面的专家了。

lines.en: : What’s so depressing about spending hundreds, if not thousands of hours seducing fictional characters?!
lines.zh: : 花上几百、甚至几千个小时去勾引虚构角色，有什么好丧气的？！

lines.en: : It's all of the fun with none of the cleanup!
lines.zh: : 快乐全都有，善后一点没有！

lines.en: : Cleanup?...
scene mollyphonegame10
: Bodily fluids! Scrunched up tissues! Messy hair! The whole kitten caboodle!
lines.zh: : 体液！揉成一团的纸巾！乱糟糟的头发！全套猫猫大礼包！

lines.en: : Wow. Your mind is even further gone than I thought.
lines.zh: : 哇。你的脑子比我以为的还要没救。

lines.en: : You’re the one who asked, Sir! Don’t pretend you don’t know what I’m talking about!
lines.zh: : 明明是您自己问的，先生！别装作听不懂我在说什么！

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame11
: Besides, who even cares if somebody is into that kinda stuff? It’s not like 2D romance hurts anybody.
lines.zh: : 再说了，谁在乎别人好哪一口呢？二次元恋爱又不会伤害到谁。

lines.en: : I know that. You can be into whatever you want to be into. I’m just messing around with you.
lines.zh: : 这我知道。你想喜欢什么就喜欢什么。我只是逗你玩而已。

lines.en: : Do I think it's depressing? Yes. But I'm not about to stand between you and whatever weird fetishes you have.
lines.zh: : 我确实觉得挺丧的，没错。但我也不打算挡在你和你那些奇怪癖好之间。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame12
: Thank you, Sir! Appreciated! I was worried we were about to reach a bad end!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，先生！感激不尽！我还担心我们就要走到坏结局了呢！

lines.en: : A bad end this early in your story would be really unfortunate.
lines.zh: : 故事才刚开始就走到坏结局，那可太惨了。

lines.en: : Reviews would plummet. I can hear it now...
lines.zh: : 评价肯定会暴跌。我现在都能听见了……

lines.en: : “This game is too hard! How do I escape the time loop?! Where is the walkthrough?!”
lines.zh: : 「这游戏太难了！我该怎么逃出时间循环？！攻略在哪儿？！」

lines.en: : I’m not sure what any of that means, but I doubt there’s anyone out there who’d be so detached from reality that they’d complain about something like that.
lines.zh: : 我不太明白这些都是什么意思，但我怀疑世上应该没有哪个脱离现实到会为这种事抱怨的人吧。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame13
: You clearly haven’t spent enough time on the Internet.
lines.zh: : 您显然在网上待得还不够久。

lines.en: : No, I really haven’t.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我确实没有。

lines.en: : It’s a freakin’ battlefield out there, Sir.
lines.zh: : 外面可是个他妈的战场啊，先生。

lines.en: : Bodies scattered across the plains...The remnants of forgotten memes, desperately clawing their way out of the depths of the Earth...
lines.zh: : 尸横遍野……被遗忘的梗的残骸，正拼命从地底深处往外爬……

lines.en: : It is literally Hell. And I haven't even told you about Twitch chat yet.
lines.zh: : 那简直就是地狱。而且我还没跟您说 Twitch 聊天室呢。

lines.en: : Well then, why do you spend so much time on the Internet if it's that horrible? Wouldn’t it be better to go out and do, you know, real-life stuff?
lines.zh: : 那既然网上这么可怕，你为什么还花那么多时间在上面？出去做点，你知道的，现实里的事不是更好吗？

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame14
: Real life is hard...
lines.zh: : 现实生活太难了……

lines.en: : The progression system is hidden...and you can’t even check your affection scores with everyone.
lines.zh: : 进度系统是隐藏的……你甚至没法查看跟每个人的好感度数值。

lines.en: : You’ve actually gotta think about stuff...and I've never been good at that.
lines.zh: : 你真的得动脑子去想事情……而我从来就不擅长这个。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame8
: You know, Sir- I read in one game that life is like a staircase. You’ve just gotta keep on climbing.
lines.zh: : 您知道吗，先生——我在某个游戏里读到过，人生就像一段楼梯。你只管一直往上爬就行了。

lines.en: : Otherwise, if you start to overthink it, you’ll have trouble taking the next step.
lines.zh: : 不然的话，你要是想得太多，就连迈出下一步都困难。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame15
: But to that, I pose a follow-up question!
lines.zh: : 但对此，我要提出一个后续问题！

lines.en: A fire ignites within Molly’s eyes as she so passionately adds to the quote she just mentioned.
lines.zh: Molly 的眼中燃起了火焰，她正无比热忱地为刚才引用的那句话做着补充。

lines.en: Like, a literal fire. There’s actual fire in her eyes. It’s terrifying.
lines.zh: 是真的火，字面意义上的火。她眼睛里真的有火在烧。太吓人了。

lines.en: : What that quote does not take into mind is the existence of the escalator!
lines.zh: : 那句话没有考虑到的是自动扶梯的存在！

lines.en: : There is a way to live life without climbing up anything!
lines.zh: : 人生是有办法不用爬任何东西的！

lines.en: : It is possible to rise by just standing still and waiting for everything to pass by you!
lines.zh: : 你只要站着不动、等一切从身边流过，就能往上升！

lines.en: : Is it fulfilling? No! But if you wind up at the same place, it’s much more economical!
lines.zh: : 这样有成就感吗？没有！但如果终点一样，那可就划算多了！

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame16
: And so I, Molly MacCormack, have vowed to live a life on the escalator.
lines.zh: : 所以我，Molly MacCormack，立誓要过一段乘自动扶梯的人生。

lines.en: : Who needs stairs when ANYTHING can be stairs?! THE WORLD IS MY STAIRCASE!
lines.zh: : 既然什么都能当楼梯，谁还需要楼梯？！整个世界都是我的楼梯！

lines.en: : Is it hot closing your eyes with fire still inside them?
lines.zh: : 眼睛里还烧着火就闭上眼，不烫吗？

lines.en: : It burns with the white hot intensity of a thousand suns.
lines.zh: : 那是用一千个太阳的白热在灼烧。

lines.en: : Then open them back up.
lines.zh: : 那就再睁开。

lines.en: : The flames have sealed my skin shut. I shall never see again.
lines.zh: : 火焰已经把我的皮肤焊死了。我再也看不见了。

lines.en: : Please cast 'Cure Wounds' as a third level spell on me, Sir.
lines.zh: : 请您对我施展三环法术「治疗伤口」吧，先生。

lines.en: : I...don’t know how to do that.
lines.zh: : 我……不知道该怎么弄。

lines.en: : Just touch my head. I’ll act out the rest.
lines.zh: : 您只要摸摸我的头就行了。剩下的我来演。

lines.en: : I can’t touch your head until we reach the $5k stretch goal.
lines.zh: : 我们得先达成五千美元的众筹目标，我才能摸你的头。

lines.en: : We hit that goal a long time ago, Sir. That line should have been changed with the revamp.
lines.zh: : 我们早就达成那个目标了，先生。那句台词应该在重制版里就改掉的。

lines.en: : Okay, but I'm still not touching your head. I don't know where it's been.
lines.zh: : 好吧，可我还是不会摸你的头。谁知道你的头去过什么地方。

lines.en: : Life truly can be cruel sometimes.
lines.zh: : 人生有时真是残酷。

lines.en: : It really can.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame7
: Regardless, I shall persevere. Even in the face of adversity, I shall not falter! I shall not admit defeat at the hands of life itself!
lines.zh: : 无论如何，我都会坚持到底。纵然面对逆境，我也绝不动摇！我绝不向生活本身认输！

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame12
: And also because...I'd be letting you down, too...
lines.zh: : 而且也是因为……我也不想让您失望……

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame6
: How was that? Did I sound like a real character in a dating sim, Sir?
lines.zh: : 怎么样？我听起来像不像恋爱游戏里一个真正的角色了，先生？

lines.en: : Have I advanced to the lead heroine role yet?
lines.zh: : 我已经晋升到第一女主角的位置了吗？

lines.en: : For someone who isn’t interested in live humans, you certainly seem pretty set on becoming an actual love interest.
lines.zh: : 对一个对活人没兴趣的人来说，你倒是挺执着于成为一个真正的恋爱对象啊。

lines.en: : Just in the metaphorical sense. I would be a horrible girlfriend if it actually came down to it.
lines.zh: : 只是在比喻意义上。真要动真格的，我会是个很糟糕的女朋友。

lines.en: : Why do you say that? You’re weird, but I think you’d be fine if you found the right partner.
lines.zh: : 为什么这么说？你是挺怪的，但我觉得只要找对了对象，你会没问题的。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame12
: Thank you, Sir! Please ignore my face if it suddenly changes colors! This always happens when I receive compliments from those I admire!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，先生！要是我脸色突然变了，请别在意！每次被我崇敬的人夸奖，我都会这样！

lines.en: : You admire me?
lines.zh: : 你崇敬我？

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame15
: Of course I admire you!
lines.zh: : 我当然崇敬您！

lines.en: : From the moment I first laid eyes on you, I knew our contract would be one strong enough to outweigh the prying eyes of any non-believer!
lines.zh: : 从我第一眼看到您起，我就知道我们的契约足够坚固，能压过任何异教徒窥探的目光！

lines.en: : Together, you and I can weed out the darkness...and bring light back to this dying world!
lines.zh: : 您和我并肩同行，就能铲除黑暗……为这个濒死的世界带回光明！

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame9
: Oh! But I raid with my guild on Tuesdays and Wednesdays, so we’ll have to weed out the darkness on the other five days of the week instead.
lines.zh: : 哦！不过周二和周三我要跟公会打团本，所以铲除黑暗得改在一周里另外五天。

lines.en: : If that's okay with you, I mean.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果您不介意的话。

lines.en: : Sure, Molly. We can weed out the darkness whenever your schedule allows for it.
lines.zh: : 当然可以，Molly。只要你的日程允许，我们随时都能去铲除黑暗。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame15
: Excellent!
lines.zh: : 太好了！

lines.en: : Thank you for understanding and accommodating my hours of availability.
lines.zh: : 谢谢您理解并迁就我的空闲时间。

lines.en: : Now, if you would also be willing to postpone the start of[school] for several hours so I can sleep in-
lines.zh: : 那么，如果我还想请您把[school]的上课时间往后推几个小时，好让我睡个懒觉——

lines.en: : Changing[school] hours isn’t really something I’m allowed to do. I would have done that a long time ago if it was.
lines.zh: : 改[school]上课时间这种事，可不是我能做的。要能做的话，我早就改了。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame5
: I figured...It was worth a shot, though...
lines.zh: : 我想也是……不过总得试一试嘛……

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame6
: I already like you more than Ms. Watabe anyway, so there’s not really any point in complaining.
lines.zh: : 反正我已经比喜欢 Watabe 老师更喜欢您了，抱怨也没什么意义。

lines.en: : Plus, I already had some friends in your class, so everything's coming up Molly!
lines.zh: : 再说，您班上本来就有我几个朋友，所以万事都在往 Molly 这边倒！

lines.en: : I just need to work on getting Tsuneyo to like stuff other than noodles and I’ll have pretty much everything I’ve ever wanted.
lines.zh: : 只要我再把 Tsuneyo 的喜好从面条上挪开一点，我想要的东西基本上就都齐了。

lines.en: : Pretty much? What else are you missing?
lines.zh: : 基本上？你还缺什么？

lines.en: : A life-sized, realistic statue of my waifu that I can hug before I go to bed at night.
lines.zh: : 一个等身大、超逼真的老婆手办，好让我每天晚上睡前抱一抱。

lines.en: : And an RTX 3080.
lines.zh: : 还有一块 RTX 3080。

lines.en: : That line didn't even need to be changed since they're still basically unavailable everywhere.
lines.zh: : 这句台词其实都不用改，因为那玩意儿到现在哪儿都买不到。

lines.en: : A...what?
lines.zh: : 什么……什么？

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter!
lines.zh: : 这不重要！

lines.en: : The point is, as long as the bond between us is not severed, I feel as if all of my dreams will come true!
lines.zh: : 重点是，只要我们之间的纽带不断，我就觉得我所有的梦想都会成真！

lines.en: : Please do not abandon me! I need you!
lines.zh: : 请不要抛弃我！我需要您！

lines.en: : Think of it like one of those recruitment systems in an MMO where we need to be next to each other to gain an EXP buff!
lines.zh: : 您就当是大型网游里那种招募系统好了，我们得待在一起才能获得经验增益！

lines.en: : Molly, I have no idea what you’re talking about.
lines.zh: : Molly，我完全听不懂你在说什么。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame12
: That’s fine! No one ever does!
lines.zh: : 没关系！从来没人听得懂！

lines.en: : I’m just happy to have met you! That’s all! Even if you don’t like anime and call me weird all the time!
lines.zh: : 我只是很高兴能遇见您！就这样！就算您不喜欢动漫，还老是说我很怪！

lines.en: As always, I have a hard time comprehending what Molly means- but I’m glad that she seems happy at the very least.
lines.zh: 一如既往，我很难理解 Molly 到底在说什么——但至少她看起来很开心，这就让我很高兴。

lines.en: The truth is, I’m starting to enjoy spending time with her as well.
lines.zh: 说实话，我也开始享受和她相处的时光了。

lines.en: There are plenty of girls in my life now with a bit more energy than I’m used to...
lines.zh: 我身边现在有不少精力旺盛得超出我习惯的女孩……

lines.en: But I think something about how I {i}never{/i} have any idea what Molly is talking about really...sets her apart from the rest.
lines.zh: 但我想，正是「我{i}永远{/i}听不懂 Molly 在说什么」这一点……让她和别人都不一样。

lines.en: Now, seeing her in a romantic light is obviously a much different question.
lines.zh: 至于要不要从恋爱的角度看她，那显然是另一回事了。

lines.en: Especially when factoring in that I...think she might only be attracted to 2D characters?
lines.zh: 更何况我……觉得她可能只对二次元角色有兴趣？

lines.en: But either way, I'm excited to see where this relationship heads...
lines.zh: 但不管怎样，我都很好奇这段关系会走向何方……

lines.en: : I'm happy to have met you too, Molly.
lines.zh: : 我也很高兴能遇见你，Molly。

lines.en: : R...Really?
lines.zh: : 真……真的吗？

lines.en: : You mean that, Sir?
lines.zh: : 您是认真的吗，先生？

lines.en: : Of course. Even if I don't like anime and call you weird all the time.
lines.zh: : 当然。就算我不喜欢动漫，还老是说你很怪。

lines.en: scene mollyphonegame11
: That's totally fine!
lines.zh: : 完全没问题！

lines.en: : I won't let you down, Sir! I promise!
lines.zh: : 我不会让您失望的，先生！我保证！

lines.en: scene black
You know, maybe this 'contract' thing won't be so bad after all.
lines.zh: 你知道吗，也许这个「契约」也没那么糟。

$ mollycafe5 = True
